purpose: Every RoR2 system the mod touches. The type and method names are candidates until checked against the game's own code.

ror2_types.about: Classes and methods involved; confirm each exists with the expected shape in the installed build.

rows.approach: Awake reads SURVIVORSQUAD_L4D2_DIR, opens the VPK index lazily and registers content. If the folder is missing or unreadable, log a clear message and do not register Coach.

rows.system: Register the survivor, body, skills and entity states with the game
rows.ror2_types: ContentManager.collectContentPackProviders; IContentPackProvider; ContentPack; SurvivorDef; SkillDef; SkillFamily; EntityState types
rows.approach: A content pack provider; skill definitions created in code.
rows.fallback: Patch the catalogs directly with Harmony.

rows.ror2_types: CharacterBody; CharacterMotor; CharacterDirection; SkillLocator; GenericSkill; ModelLocator; CameraTargetParams; HealthComponent; TeamComponent; NetworkIdentity
rows.approach: Clone an existing survivor body prefab for its components, then swap in the model and stats from the survivors sheet.
rows.fallback: Build the component set by hand.

rows.system: Turn decoded Source data into a skinned model with hurtboxes
rows.ror2_types: SkinnedMeshRenderer; Mesh.bindposes; CharacterModel; ChildLocator; HurtBoxGroup; HurtBox; CapsuleCollider
rows.approach: Build mesh, bones and materials at runtime from the MDL, VVD and VTX readers; pick shaders that fit RoR2's deferred rendering.
rows.fallback: If skinned models cannot be made reliable, stop and report. No stand-in.

rows.system: Play Source animations on the Coach model
rows.ror2_types: EntityState.PlayAnimation; Animator (bypass or shim); a custom bone sampler in LateUpdate
rows.approach: Decode sequences (including .ani blocks) and sample bones ourselves; map RoR2 animation requests to sequences from the animations sheet; support pose-parameter blends for locomotion.
rows.fallback: Cut to a core set (idle, run, fire, reload, shove, throw) and report which sequences failed.

rows.approach: Build a display prefab from the same model; render a portrait still from it.

rows.system: Skill variants on the loadout screen
rows.ror2_types: SkillFamily.variants; LoadoutPanelController; Loadout; skill icon Sprites
rows.approach: One family per slot; primary and special have several variants; icons are rendered from models.

rows.ror2_types: BulletAttack (damage, bulletCount, spread, falloffModel, maxDistance, procCoefficient, tracer and hit effect prefabs)
rows.approach: One entity state per gun reads its weapons row; tracers and hit effects are RoR2's own.

rows.ror2_types: a custom ammo component on the body; GenericSkill stock (not used for ammo)
rows.approach: An ammo counter per weapon; reload starts when empty; firing is locked while reloading.
rows.fallback: Use skill stock with a recharge as the clip.

rows.ror2_types: BlastAttack or OverlapAttack; DamageType stun; knockback through DamageInfo.force or CharacterMotor.ApplyForce
rows.approach: A cone check in front of the body that stuns and pushes.

rows.ror2_types: ProjectileController; ProjectileSimple; ProjectileImpactExplosion; ProjectileDamage; ProjectileCatalog registration
rows.approach: One projectile prefab per throwable with its L4D2 model; registered so it is valid in the network layer even in solo.

rows.ror2_types: BlastAttack; DotController.InflictDot (Burn); a fire-pool style damage zone
rows.approach: Pipe bomb blast and Molotov fire pool using RoR2 effect prefabs.

rows.ror2_types: BuffDef; CharacterBody.HasBuff; BaseAI target override; RecalculateStats or TakeDamage hook for +damage taken
rows.approach: A custom buff; a Harmony patch on AI target selection toward the bomb or splash.
rows.fallback: See lure_fallback in the throwables sheet.

rows.approach: A timed buff for move speed and attack speed plus a little barrier.

rows.system: Play decoded L4D2 sounds and voice
rows.ror2_types: AudioSource; AudioClip.Create; the game's volume settings
rows.approach: Decode on a background thread, cache clips in memory, play through AudioSources on the body, and follow the game's master and effects volume.
rows.fallback: Silence the sound and log it.

rows.ror2_types: GlobalEventManager.onCharacterDeathGlobal; Run.onRunStartGlobal; a HealthComponent damage hook; TeleporterInteraction events; boss spawn from the combat director
rows.approach: Subscribe once; a small scheduler applies cooldown, chance and priority from the voice sheet.
rows.fallback: Drop any trigger whose event cannot be hooked.

rows.ror2_types: PreGameController or lobby state; NetworkUser count; survivor availability
rows.approach: Offer Coach only in a solo lobby; hide him if a second player joins.
rows.fallback: State clearly in the listing that co-op is unsupported.

rows.approach: Inject English strings for every token in the survivors and skills sheets.
A few options: voice volume and voice frequency.
